rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium table in 31.13.01.15A, by number of months insured (2 to 120) and 7-, 14- or 30-day period, benefits not retroactive or retroactive; other terms by straight-line interpolation. Joint coverage is at most 1.80 times single (F). The chapter history lists .15A and E as amended effective June 1, 2016 (43:5 Md. R. 387); the MIA's Bulletin 16-11 of April 6, 2016 (a scanned image, not saved) describes that amendment as a reduction of the monthly outstanding balance composite rates in .15E (record MD-CD-2016-06-01) and says credit health prima facie rates had not been revised since 2001. Also saved: archive/MD/2026-11-21_2756d5ab.html (MD-COMAR-31.13.01.html).
source_title: COMAR 31.13.01.15 Prima Facie Premium Rates for Credit Health Insurance (Library of Maryland Regulations)
summary: Rates in force: Maryland's prima facie single premium credit health rates in COMAR 31.13.01.15A, per $100 of initial amount of insured indebtedness, for 12 and 60 months and 7-, 14- and 30-day periods, retroactive or not. The regulation says its rates apply to all premiums charged on or after March 1, 2001. Section A was amended effective June 1, 2016; the amendment is described as changing the outstanding balance rates in section E only, which is not confirmed from an official text copy.
